name: Goat, Giant
otherStatistics: Ability modifiers STR +3, DEX +0, CON +1, INT -4, WIS +1, CHA -2. Fixed Perception 11. Fixed Stealth 10. No special senses or languages. AC includes natural armor. Resistant to prone, with advantage on rolls and saves to prevent or end the condition.
appearance: A shaggy gray-tan goat with a pointed beard, cloven hooves, and long horns sweeping back from its head.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Monster Vault (2024), translated by Andrea Iglesias as Cubil de Monstruos (Nosolorol, 2025), Cabra, Gigante, printed p. 338, p. 340. ISBN 979-13-87882-04-4. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits: Charge. If the goat moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with Ram on the same turn, the target takes an extra 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit this way must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.Actions: Ram. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Terrifying Scream. When the goat takes damage, it can scream. Every creature within 10 ft. that hears it must make a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, a creature is frightened until the end of its next turn. After being frightened this way, that creature cannot be frightened by this goat’s scream again for 24 hours.

name: Hawk
otherStatistics: Ability modifiers STR -3, DEX +1, CON -1, INT -4, WIS +2, CHA -2. Fixed Perception 14. Fixed Stealth 11. No special senses or languages.
appearance: A brown raptor with mottled cream breast feathers, a hooked beak, and yellow talons.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Monster Vault (2024), translated by Andrea Iglesias as Cubil de Monstruos (Nosolorol, 2025), Halcón, printed p. 342, p. 344. ISBN 979-13-87882-04-4. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits: Keen Sight. The hawk’s Perception is 19 when it relies on sight.
sections.Actions: Talons. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Evasive Flight. While flying, the hawk can use this bonus action to Disengage or Dodge.

name: Hawk, Blood
otherStatistics: Ability modifiers STR -2, DEX +2, CON +0, INT -4, WIS +2, CHA -3. Fixed Perception 14. Fixed Stealth 12. No special senses or languages.
appearance: A perched hawk with russet wing coverts, dark wing and tail bars, and a streaked cream chest.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Monster Vault (2024), translated by Andrea Iglesias as Cubil de Monstruos (Nosolorol, 2025), Halcón, Sangriento, printed p. 342, p. 344. ISBN 979-13-87882-04-4. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits:
Keen Sight. The hawk’s Perception is 19 when it relies on sight.

Pack Tactics. The hawk has advantage when attacking a creature within 5 ft. of one of its allies, provided that ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Beak. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Evasive Flight. While flying, the hawk can use this bonus action to Disengage or Dodge.

name: Hippocampus
otherStatistics: Ability modifiers STR +4, DEX +1, CON +1, INT -4, WIS +1, CHA -1. Fixed Perception 13. Fixed Stealth 11. Cold resistance. Darkvision 60 ft. No languages.
appearance: A blue-green creature with a horse’s head and forelegs, fine scales, a fin along the neck, and a long fish tail.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Monster Vault (2024), translated by Andrea Iglesias as Cubil de Monstruos (Nosolorol, 2025), Hipocampo, printed p. 229, p. 231. ISBN 979-13-87882-04-4. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The hippocampus breathes air and water.

Shared Breathing. Its gills release spare air through the neck and back as bubbles. These bubbles can supply an air-breathing creature riding it with fresh air while the hippocampus is neither fighting nor traveling at high speed.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail Slap.

Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

Tail Slap. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Rearing Kick. The hippocampus rears and kicks at a creature it can see within 5 ft. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength save. On a failure the hippocampus chooses whether to knock it prone or push it up to 10 ft. away.
sections.Encounter notes: Herds of eight to twenty graze on algae and other aquatic plants. They favor warm, shallow coastal water, range into colder depths to feed, and return to sheltered bays and coves after dark. Aquatic humanoids use them as mounts and to tow cargo.

name: Horse, Draft
otherStatistics: Ability modifiers STR +4, DEX +0, CON +1, INT -4, WIS +0, CHA -2. Fixed Perception 12. Fixed Stealth 10. No special senses or languages. Vulnerable to frightened, with disadvantage on rolls and saves to prevent or end the condition.
appearance: A muscular brown horse with a broad chest, pale feathering above the hooves, and a dark mane and tail.

sections.Printed source: Kobold Press, Monster Vault (2024), translated by Andrea Iglesias as Cubil de Monstruos (Nosolorol, 2025), Caballo, tiro, printed p. 338, p. 340. ISBN 979-13-87882-04-4. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits: Draft Animal. The horse can push, drag, or lift weight in pounds equal to three times its carrying capacity.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
